TITLE: Freshem subsurface resistivity model (Zeeland)
DESCRIPTION: Airborne electromagnetic (AEM) derived 3D subsurface electrical resistivity model for the Freshem project, covering the Zeeland survey area. The cube provides resistivity percentiles (Q05-Q95), hydraulic conductivity (K), lithoclass, depth-of-investigation and the top/bottom elevation of each depth layer on a regular x/y grid in the Dutch RD New projection (EPSG:28992), with a non-uniform vertical (z) axis following the original layer boundaries (no vertical interpolation).
SHORT_DESCRIPTION: 3D airborne-EM resistivity and derived hydrogeological properties (Zarr datacube).

PROVIDERS.name: Deltares

HISTORY: Freshem prepare_data.py: NetCDF (layer top/bottom + resistivity percentiles) resampled to regular x/y grid, converted to Zarr, variable names made Zarr/NTFS safe (Z -> Z_orig)
AUTHOR: Deltares
CITATION: Deltares Freshem project - airborne electromagnetic resistivity model
COMMENT: Vertical axis z is layer-based, not a uniform grid: top/bottom variables give the real upper/lower elevation (m, Dutch NAP datum) of each layer at every x/y/z cell, so several z indices can share the same top or bottom. No interpolation is applied along z; values are the original per-layer values.
